controlled_pdf_table.scope: single controlled table; not general table accuracy

findings: Both tools matched the assistant-reviewed expected first row of 8 selected real CSV files; these are not human-labelled general accuracy results.
Fess supported the explicitly configured CP950 and headerless cases; pinned Docling CSV handling did not support those overrides.
Malformed CSV produced parsing failures. Direct parser acceptance of a mislabeled HTML resource did not establish CSV format; the separate Tika check identified HTML.
Fess yielded ordinary PDF text, with no structured cell model and no OCR in this experiment.
Docling fast table reconstruction misassociated values in one controlled table; accurate mode matched that single 9-cell expected table.
OCR produced text for controlled and selected Chinese scans, but character and table accuracy were not evaluated.
limitations: 20 selected cases: 8 real CSV, 3 real PDF and 9 controls, not a whole-catalog success-rate sample.
OCR character count and nonempty output are not correctness metrics.
Fess text extraction and Docling layout/table/OCR are different workloads; timings are not a speed ranking.
Fixed image/tool versions only; findings do not establish the behavior of future versions.
No product code, production index, retrieval quality or deployment changed in the original experiment.
